title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The rollout, licensing and configuration instructions are supported, and the briefing correctly reports the conflicting Android availability documentation. One compliance caveat needs narrowing: Microsoft lists the retention-label limitation for Facilitator generally, not just for scheduled meetings, so its applicability should not be described as unpublished.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The applicability of the meeting-specific eDiscovery cloud-attachment collection limitation to in-person notes is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in-person notes retention labels cloud attachments eDiscovery limitations. Opened Learn /microsoftteams/facilitator-teams, /rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and /purview/ai-teams-facilitator; none resolves in-person collection of cloud attachments.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions: Facilitator limits
claims.claim: Learn does not say whether the retention-label limitation for cloud attachments covers in-person Facilitator notes.
claims.quote:
Use Facilitator in:
- Meetings
- Teams Rooms

Facilitator limitations
Facilitator currently has the following limitations:
Retention labels aren't supported for cloud attachments in AI-generated notes.
claims.fix: Replace the compliance-limits bullet in Risk assessment with: 'Learn lists a general Facilitator limitation: retention labels are not supported for cloud attachments in AI-generated notes. For Facilitator in meetings, it also says AI-generated notes are not automatically collected as cloud attachments in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery. Learn does not say whether that meeting-specific collection limitation covers in-person notes.' Replace the combined limits question in Open questions with: 'Does the meeting-specific eDiscovery cloud-attachment collection limitation apply to notes taken in person? Watch the Set up Facilitator in Microsoft Teams page.' Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/facilitator-teams#facilitator-limitations.

go to Meetings > Meeting policies.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription through the Global meeting policy.
claims.quote:
To allow everyone in your organization to transcribe meetings, events, and group calls, except users with an assigned custom meeting policy, run the following command:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls; Open questions: transcription
claims.claim: The setup documentation points to general meeting transcription without specifying which account's policy governs in-person note-taking.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in-person Teams Rooms transcription policy resource account organizer. Opened Rooms Facilitator and meeting-transcription-captions; read Rooms Copilot overview excerpts. No source specifies the governing account for in-person notes.

claims.claim: SharePoint PowerShell Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true enables Loop components in Teams.
claims.quote: To enable Loop components in Teams, run Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true.

claims.claim: SharePoint PowerShell Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true enables collaborative meeting notes.
claims.quote:
Collaborative meeting notes in Teams | SharePoint PowerShell | Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled
[Teams-only] Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true, Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true

claims.claim: An admin-centre path for IsLoopEnabled is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: IsLoopEnabled admin center. Read Loop admin policies in full relevant sections and search excerpts. The Microsoft 365 admin-centre checkbox controls Loop workspaces, not this Teams property; Teams configuration uses SharePoint PowerShell.

claims.claim: An admin-centre path for IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin center. Read Loop admin policies and Facilitator setup sections and matching search excerpts; they document SharePoint PowerShell for this property, not an admin-centre path.

claims.claim: IsLoopEnabled applies tenant-wide and cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: Loop components in Teams | IsLoopEnabled (boolean) | This property controls Loop component creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled applies tenant-wide and cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: This property controls the collaborative meeting notes creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: The SharePoint collaborative meeting notes property does not apply to Teams New Calendar notes.
claims.quote: The SharePoint organization property doesn't apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar, see Settings management in Cloud Policy.

claims.claim: Facilitator can be allowed or blocked through Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > actions menu > Allow or Block.
claims.quote:
In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps.
In the apps list's search box, search for Facilitator.
Select Facilitator from the app list.
In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: Facilitator is allowed by default.
claims.quote: Facilitator is allowed by default.

claims.claim: Facilitator is blocked if all apps are blocked for the organisation.
claims.quote: However, if all apps are blocked for your organization, Facilitator is also blocked.

claims.claim: The Facilitator app must be enabled for the room resource account, explicitly including it when availability is scoped to People and Groups.
claims.quote: Enable Facilitator app for the room resource account in the Teams admin center. If app availability is set to Everyone, the room account is included. If availability is scoped to People and Groups, include the Teams Rooms resource account.

claims.claim: The room-level portal note-taking setting is one of Learn's setup prerequisites.
claims.quote:

claims.claim: The general meeting transcription control is a user-scoped meeting policy setting.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting. For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.
